    • assertDeletable

      public void assertDeletable(Integer idTradingCalendarRuleSet)
      Description copied from interface: TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepositoryCustom
      Refuses the deletion of a rule set that is still referenced, either by a stock exchange whose trading calendar it produces or by another rule set that extends it. Deleting it would leave the exchange without a calendar source or the extending set without its inherited rules.
      Specified by:
      assertDeletable in interface TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepositoryCustom
      Parameters:
      idTradingCalendarRuleSet - the rule set about to be deleted

    • previewClosures

      public SortedMap<String,String> previewClosures(Integer idTradingCalendarRuleSet, String ruleYaml, int year)
      Description copied from interface: TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepositoryCustom
      Resolves a rule set and returns the closures of one year together with the name of the rule that produced each one. Drives the preview in the rule editor, so the user sees the effect of a rule before saving it.
      Specified by:
      previewClosures in interface TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepositoryCustom
      Parameters:
      idTradingCalendarRuleSet - the rule set to evaluate
      ruleYaml - unsaved YAML to evaluate instead of the persisted text, may be null
      year - the year for which the closures are wanted
      Returns:
      map from closure date to rule name, in ascending date order
